hypothesis: A small query-based interval-set detector can recover long offset, drift, and noise events that the frozen high-precision Round-B row classifier misses, while an anchor-preserving union prevents any incumbent positive from being removed.

research_basis.selected_family: TE-TAD/TadTR-style direct temporal interval set prediction
research_basis.selection_reason: It changes the prediction unit from independent rows to unordered event intervals and directly targets the observed long-event false-negative concentration.
research_basis.non_selected_fallback: target-free change-point proposal plus segment rescore; requires a separate preregistration if this cycle terminates

frozen_round_b_prediction_parts.bit_identity_requirement: must equal frozen_round_b_anchor.round_b_prediction on all 421032 ordered keys

data_binding.segment_break: station/year/layer change or timestamp difference not exactly 10 minutes

target_definition.multi_type_membership: a row is eligible once when its plus-delimited anomaly_type contains at least one of offset, drift, or noise
target_definition.event_component: maximal binary union run of eligible rows within one exact-cadence station/year/layer segment; type changes inside the run do not create duplicate targets
target_definition.boundary_censor_policy: clip each qualifying original event to the window and train the clipped fragment, even when the fragment is shorter than 19 rows
target_definition.cutoff_censor_policy: for each phase first project labels to time < cutoff, then build events; exclude a right-censored run that reaches the prefix tail when the next exact-cadence row would be at or after cutoff
target_definition.query_overflow_policy: hard fail before any fit when targets in a window exceed 5

preprocessing.numeric_transform: median and IQR scaling; nonfinite becomes zero after scaling; append one missingness indicator per numeric feature
preprocessing.additional_channels: train-prefix station one-hot; unseen station is the all-zero vector; robust-scaled numeric layer; valid-row mask
preprocessing.effective_channel_order: 46 scaled numeric, 46 numeric-missing indicators, 3 lexically sorted station indicators, scaled layer, valid-row mask

windowing.generation_order: split first, then exact-cadence segment, then window
windowing.starts: 0, 512, ... plus max(segment_length-1024, 0) when not already present
windowing.short_segment_policy: one right-zero-padded window; valid-row channel is zero on padding; predictions clipped to valid length

train_validation_raw_dependency_guard.assertion: the raw-row dependency sets of every training window and validation window are disjoint

architecture.name: TE-TAD-lite-tinygrad
architecture.matching: detached SciPy Hungarian assignment using class + endpoint L1 + 1D IoU cost

runtime.gpu_requirement: an RTX-class CUDA parameter device must be observed before the sanity optimizer run

windows_cuda_loader_patch.purpose: allow PTX-only compilation when blocked nvrtc/nvjitlink DLLs cannot be imported; nvcuda.dll remains required

training.positive_windows: all windows intersecting at least one qualifying event
training.negative_selection: selected once before fitting by ascending SHA256(seed|fold|station|year|layer|window_start_time); the fixed sample is reused every epoch
training.epoch_definition: all positive windows plus the single pre-fit deterministic negative selection exactly once in a seeded permutation

implementation_sanity_gate.selection: first 16 target windows and first 16 empty windows by registered SHA256 order
implementation_sanity_gate.failure_action: NO_GO_IMPLEMENTATION_GATE; no outer fit or score

q2.role: design-only threshold selection; excluded from confirmation evidence
q2.selection: maximum anchor-union micro-F1; exact tie chooses the highest threshold
q2.kill_if: all thresholds add zero rows, best delta F1 <= 0, or added-row precision <= anchor F1 / 2

chronological_protocol.interpretation: historical reuse-stability evidence, not a fresh untouched holdout

decode_and_stitch.subminimum_proposal_action: discard; never expand a proposal and never use the generic one-cell rasterizer
decode_and_stitch.overlap_rule: per-row maximum query sigmoid confidence across every covering validation window
decode_and_stitch.candidate: bitwise OR of frozen Round-B anchor and thresholded stitched detector rows

outer_decision.bootstrap_algorithm: sample exactly the observed number of segments with replacement; concatenate all rows from sampled segments with multiplicity; compute candidate F1 minus anchor F1; CI90 is the simple 5th and 95th percentiles of 2000 paired deltas
outer_decision.normal_false_positive_day_definition: normal-row exposure days = count(label=0)/144; compare candidate FP/exposure to anchor FP/exposure; if anchor FP is zero, only candidate FP zero passes
outer_decision.worst_slice_definition: pool q3+q4, retain station/layer groups with at least 50 positive rows, then take the minimum of candidate F1 minus anchor F1

execution_integrity.single_attempt_lock: artifacts/p1_tetad_lite_direct_interval_set_v1.ATTEMPT_LOCK.json created with O_EXCL before the sanity fit
execution_integrity.existing_attempt_or_terminal_receipt: fail closed; no second optimizer run
execution_integrity.execution_seal: before the lock, bind SHA-256 of this config, runner, model module, experiment module, tests, tinygrad version, and the patched CUDA:PTX compiler support file
execution_integrity.prediction_commit_meaning: an atomic local score array plus SHA-256 receipt; never a Git commit
execution_integrity.q2_truth_firewall: OOF key/fold columns may be projected for membership, but q2 label/anomaly_type cannot be collected until the q2 blind-score receipt exists
execution_integrity.q3_q4_truth_firewall: each fold label/anomaly_type cannot be collected until that fold blind-score receipt exists
execution_integrity.technical_failure_after_lock: terminal technical failure; no silent retry or hyperparameter change

query_preflight.event_definition: the registered binary union and cutoff-censor rule
